description: An oscillator whose phase is bent by one of eight hard shapes, giving harsh phase distorted waves

params.text: Sets the pitch, -4 to 4 as a power of two around middle C, which is about 16Hz to 4186Hz
Scales the voltage at the FM jack, 0 to 300 per cent
While on, the FM jack is added to the frequency in hertz rather than to the pitch in octaves, which gives through-zero frequency modulation
Sets how far the shape bends the phase, 0 to 4; at 0 the wave is left as it is
Attenuates the voltage at the Depth jack before it is added to the Depth knob, 0 to 1
Picks the shape the phase is bent by: WRAP, PULSE, BUZZ, WRINKLE, SIN_WRAP, SIN_PULSE, SIN_BUZZ or SIN_WRINKLE

inputs.text: Sets the pitch by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
Modulates the frequency through the FM knob; with Lin off it is added to the pitch in octaves, and with Lin on it is added to the frequency itself, which lets it pass through zero
Modulates that amount, a tenth per volt scaled by the Depth CV knob

notes: the wave is worked out sixteen times over per sample and filtered, which is what keeps these hard shapes usable at pitch

inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 4V.
